title: Targeting pancreatic cancer progression: The formononetin and salvianolic acid B combination suppresses JAK/STAT signaling via MBOAT2 downregulation.
authors: Xu, Ying; Xu, Chen-Shan; Jin, Hang-Bin; Gu, Wei-Gang; Shen, Hong-Zhang; Lu, Lei; Chen, Yan; Xu, Dong-Chao; Zhang, Xiao-Feng; Yang, Jian-Feng; Wang, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分组合通过下调MBOAT2抑制JAK/STAT信号通路治疗胰腺癌，仅涉及分子对接初步预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Formononetin and salvianolic acid B (FcS) are the primary bioactive components of the Astragalus mongholicus-Salvia miltiorrhiza herbal pair, a classic combination for treating pancreatic cancer associated with qi deficiency and blood stasis. This study elucidates the therapeutic potential and mechanisms of FcS in the treatment of pancreatic cancer. METHODS: A zebrafish xenograft model was used to screen bioactive combinations derived from A. mongholicus and S. miltiorrhiza, identifying FcS as a candidate with antitumor activity. Its efficacy was evaluated in vivo using the zebrafish model, orthotopic LSL-Kras(G12D/+), LSL-Trp53(R172H/+) and Pdx-1-Cre (KPC) mice, and subcutaneous xenograft models. Cell viability and proliferation were assessed using cell counting kit-8, 5-ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine and colony formation assays, and migration and invasion were evaluated by wound healing and transwell assays. Membrane-bound O-acyltransferase 2 (MBOAT2) was identified as a potential target through a molecular docking study and the Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) analysis. MBOAT2 knockdown cells were used to explore its roles and the Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK/STAT) signaling pathway in FcS-mediated inhibition. RESULTS: In the zebrafish model, FcS strongly inhibited pancreatic tumor growth. FcS reduced tumor volume, the expression of proliferation marker Ki-67, and proliferating cell nuclear antigen in KPC mice. In vitro, FcS inhibited pancreatic cancer cell viability, proliferation, migration and invasion, which was accompanied by downregulation of MBOAT2 expression. TCGA analysis linked high MBOAT2 expression to aggressive phenotypes. MBOAT2 knockdown reduced the survival, proliferation and invasion of BxPC-3 cells. Rescue experiments revealed that MBOAT2 knockdown attenuated the antitumor effects of FcS, possibly through modulation of the JAK/STAT signaling pathway. FcS also inhibited tumor proliferation in xenograft models, and MBOAT2 expression was elevated in tumor tissues from pancreatic cancer patients. CONCLUSION: FcS suppresses pancreatic cancer progression via MBOAT2 downregulation and JAK/STAT pathway inhibition, which highlights MBOAT2 as a potential therapeutic target. Please cite this article as: Xu Y, Xu CS, Jin HB, Gu WG, Shen HZ, Lu L, Chen Y, Xu DC, Zhang XF, Yang JF, Wang Y. Targeting pancreatic cancer progression: The formononetin and salvianolic acid B combination suppresses JAK/STAT signaling via MBOAT2 downregulation. J Integr Med. 2026; 24(5):725-741.
abstract_zh: 目的：芒柄花素和丹酚酸B（FcS）是黄芪-丹参药对的主要生物活性成分，该药对是治疗气虚血瘀型胰腺癌的经典组合。本研究旨在阐明FcS治疗胰腺癌的治疗潜力及其作用机制。方法：采用斑马鱼异种移植模型筛选黄芪和丹参中的生物活性组合，确定FcS为具有抗肿瘤活性的候选药物。通过斑马鱼模型、原位LSL-Kras(G12D/+)、LSL-Trp53(R172H/+)和Pdx-1-Cre（KPC）小鼠以及皮下异种移植模型，在体内评估其疗效。使用细胞计数试剂盒-8、5-乙炔基-2'-脱氧尿苷和集落形成实验评估细胞活力和增殖，通过伤口愈合和Transwell实验评估迁移和侵袭。通过分子对接研究和癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）分析，将膜结合O-酰基转移酶2（MBOAT2）确定为潜在靶点。使用MBOAT2敲低细胞探讨其在FcS介导的抑制中的作用及Janus激酶/信号转导和转录激活因子（JAK/STAT）信号通路。结果：在斑马鱼模型中，FcS强烈抑制胰腺肿瘤生长。FcS降低了KPC小鼠的肿瘤体积、增殖标志物Ki-67的表达和增殖细胞核抗原。在体外，FcS抑制胰腺癌细胞活力、增殖、迁移和侵袭，并伴随MBOAT2表达下调。TCGA分析将高MBOAT2表达与侵袭性表型相关联。MBOAT2敲低降低了BxPC-3细胞的存活、增殖和侵袭。拯救实验表明，MBOAT2敲低减弱了FcS的抗肿瘤效应，可能通过调节JAK/STAT信号通路实现。FcS还抑制了异种移植模型中的肿瘤增殖，且胰腺癌患者肿瘤组织中MBOAT2表达升高。结论：FcS通过下调MBOAT2和抑制JAK/STAT通路抑制胰腺癌进展，这凸显了MBOAT2作为潜在治疗靶点的价值。请引用本文为：Xu Y, Xu CS, Jin HB, Gu WG, Shen HZ, Lu L, Chen Y, Xu DC, Zhang XF, Yang JF, Wang Y. Targeting pancreatic cancer progression: The formononetin and salvianolic acid B combination suppresses JAK/STAT signaling via MBOAT2 downregulation. J Integr Med. 2026; 24(5):725-741.
